messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "body needs time to make own steroid hormones"
set: ["body needs time to make own steroid hormones", "make decision with doctor rather than stopping on own", "adrenal glands need time to restart hormone production after steroid use", "needs to be taken daily to work properly", "long-term steroid treatment", "these can make your body absorb less of the medicine", "dose schedule adjusted to individual patient's needs", "to make swallowing easier, may open capsule", "start steroid medicine before levothyroxine", "does not need to be tapered like a steroid", "doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it", "make the medication less appealing to children and pets", "do not stop treatment on your own", "patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "some conditions require steroid treatment during pregnancy", "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
